And usually the person who wants to combine hasn't done a good enough job asking questions to dig into those reasons for them to feel seen and heard to go, "Oh, I actually understand why you feel that way. the way you grew up, it was scarcity or there was trauma or there was a divorce and my parent or friend wasn't safe because they had combined finances and it put them in a precarious situation. The more you can ask questions and dig, the more you can get to some empathy and understanding.
